symbols.name: fractional bits
symbols.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the stored grid, so values are integers divided by 2^p.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be the number of fractional bits, so stored values lie on the grid $2^{-p}\mathbb Z[i]$.

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: The number of operations applied since the layer began.
symbols.quote: After $k$ such operations, where $k$ counts the operations applied since the layer began, a value lies in $2^{-(p+k)}\mathbb Z[i]$ and has modulus at most $2^k$.

symbols.name: extra reserved bits
symbols.meaning: The number of extra bits reserved, at least the number of operations charged to the layer.
symbols.quote: Let $\Delta$ be the number of extra bits reserved, at least the number of operations charged to the layer.

symbols.name: truncation
symbols.meaning: The single truncation that drops the bits below 2^{-p} in each real and imaginary part.
symbols.quote: The truncation $Q_p$ drops the bits below $2^{-p}$ in each real and imaginary part, returning the record to the $p$-bit grid, with error below $\sqrt2\,2^{-p}$ per complex coefficient.

relations.quote: A record is laid out on the tapes of the [Fixed finite-tape machine model](machine-model.md) as $2r$ consecutive fixed-width integers, so it is read and moved by ordinary tape scans.
